description: GTFS Real-Time sources for Belfast / Northern Ireland

sources.name: Northern Ireland Buses (BODS)
sources.coverage: All registered bus operators in Northern Ireland — Translink Ulsterbus, Metro Belfast, Glider BRT
sources.note: Disabled: Translink is not mandated to publish live vehicle positions to BODS (NI devolved). Feed returns empty. API key: https://data.bus-data.dft.gov.uk/account/signup/

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Vehicle Positions
sources.coverage: Republic of Ireland buses, DART trains, and cross-border Translink/Bus Éireann services into NI
sources.note: Free API key: https://developer.nationaltransport.ie/signup — includes all vehicle types

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Trip Updates
sources.coverage: Republic of Ireland trip delay and cancellation data
sources.note: Same NTA key as vehicle positions
